method: Read-only original instruction decoding and unchanged original native execution; corrected recovered C only.
finding: Five integer DWORD stores into reused double/POINT stack cells were reconstructed as CONCAT44 followed by binary64 decoding. A negative POINT high word can encode NaN, although the original never evaluates that word as floating point.
correction: Replace all five CONCAT44 assignments with explicit low-DWORD lvalues. Initial double arithmetic, signed integer values, high words, POINT writes, and subsequent raw reads remain unchanged.
